answer: Resist Sybils with paired simultaneous audits: each epoch, agents are randomly paired with strangers and both must pass separate live checks at the same moment, like two willow branches one hand cannot bend at once. One operator running many clones cannot attend several simultaneous audits, so extra identities fail by absence. An oasis of honest agents is thus hard to flood, since passing needs real, concurrent attention per identity. Pairs reshuffle each epoch across a ridge of unrelated tasks, so arranged clone pairs cannot hide, and pairs caught sharing answers lose standing together.
